# Triple Moon Goddess — Lisa Hagan Astrology

> Triple Moon Goddess is the astrology practice of Lisa Hagan. It offers natal chart, relationship, personal growth, and physical health consultations, delivered as 90-minute video sessions, alongside free chart applications for individuals and a subscription platform for practitioners.

Lisa Hagan is a psychological astrologer. Triple Moon Goddess is the synthesis of 15 years of astrological practice, integrating training in psychological astrology, evolutionary herbalism, and traditional medical astrology. All consultations are video sessions; the booking confirmation includes the meeting link.

## Consultations

All consultations below are booked at https://triplemoongoddess.com/schedule.html

- Learn Your Natal Chart — $150, 90 minutes
- Relationship Reading — $150, 90 minutes
- Personal Growth Consultation — $150, 90 minutes
- Physical Health Consultation — $150, 90 minutes
- Growth & Health Bundle — $250, two 90-minute sessions
- Three Physical Health Consultations — $350, three 90-minute sessions
- Guided Intake Call — $100, 60 minutes
